title: v2: speaker embedder (sherpa) and enroll-from-audio use case
description: Compute a voice embedding from audio samples with sherpa-onnx's SpeakerEmbeddingExtractor and enroll a named speaker from a recorded sample (goal 5).
steps: Create `diarization/SpeakerEmbedder.kt`: `interface SpeakerEmbedder : Closeable { fun embed(samples: FloatArray): FloatArray }` and `fun interface SpeakerEmbedderFactory { fun create(): SpeakerEmbedder }`.

Create `engine/sherpa/SherpaSpeakerEmbedder.kt`: holds `SpeakerEmbeddingExtractor(assetManager = null, config = SpeakerEmbeddingExtractorConfig(model = <abs path of wespeaker_en_voxceleb_resnet34_LM.onnx>, numThreads = n))`. `embed`: `val stream = extractor.createStream(); stream.acceptWaveform(samples, 16000); stream.inputFinished(); check(extractor.isReady(stream)) { "Audio too short for a voice sample" }; val e = extractor.compute(stream); stream.release(); return e`. `close()` → `extractor.release()`. Factory `SherpaSpeakerEmbedderFactory(store, settings)` analogous to `SherpaDiarizerFactory` (throws if the EMBEDDING bundle is missing). Add `speakerEmbedderFactory` to `AppContainer`.

Create `diarization/EnrollSpeakerUseCase.kt`: `class EnrollSpeakerUseCase(private val audioSource: AudioSource, private val embedderFactory: SpeakerEmbedderFactory, private val repo: EnrolledSpeakerStore)`. `suspend fun record(durationMs: Long = 15_000, onProgress: (Float) -> Unit): FloatArray` collects `audioSource.chunks()` until enough samples (16 samples per ms), converting with `toFloatSamples()`. `suspend fun enroll(name: String, samples: FloatArray)`: require name not blank and samples ≥ 3 s (48 000), compute `embedderFactory.create().use { it.embed(samples) }` on `Dispatchers.Default`, `repo.save(name.trim(), embedding)`.

Write `diarization/EnrollSpeakerUseCaseTest.kt` with a fake AudioSource (emits 1600-sample chunks forever), fake embedder (returns `floatArrayOf(samples.size.toFloat(), 1f)`), and an in-memory fake `EnrolledSpeakerStore`.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: `record(1000)` returns exactly 16 000 samples (truncate the final chunk) and progress reaches 1.0
Test: `enroll(" Alice ", 64 000 samples)` saves name `Alice` with the fake embedding
Test: `enroll` with 16 000 samples or a blank name throws IllegalArgumentException and saves nothing
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
notes: sherpa API (v1.13.8, package `com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx`): `SpeakerEmbeddingExtractor(assetManager: AssetManager? = null, config)`, `createStream(): OnlineStream`, `isReady(stream)`, `compute(stream): FloatArray`, `dim()`, `release()`; `OnlineStream.acceptWaveform(samples, sampleRate)`, `inputFinished()`, `release()`. | Always: run `source scripts/env.sh` before Gradle; the verify command is `source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`; run `./gradlew --stop` before ending. Never instantiate `com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx` classes in unit tests and only reference them inside package `com.convoscribe.engine.sherpa`. Source root: `app/src/main/java/com/convoscribe/`, tests: `app/src/test/java/com/convoscribe/`.
